A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''child''' lived on the [[Methane/Legends|methane]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farstine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Youngling/Legends|child]] was reserved and well-mannered, intelligent but eager to participate in adventures. Orphaned when his parents were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during their [[Occupation of Farstine|occupation]] of the planet, the child became homeless and was without [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]]. Down to his last fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], the child faced his own death with dignity, but was rescued by a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] who took pity on him as he reminded the hunter of their own [[Unidentified bounty hunter's brother|younger brother]] who had died at an early age.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Ah&hellip; I was thinking of playing this one a little differently. Like, a properly-brought-up Upper Class British kid.|The child's fictitious player brainstorms the characters personality|<ref name="RPG" />}}
The child was first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] as an example of how players could connect their characters' backstories in the game. The book provides a hypothetical discussion between fictitious roleplayers, one of which chooses to use the "Kid" character template. The dialogue describes the child as having an "[[Wikipedia:Social class in the United Kingdom|Upper Class British]]" style.<ref name="RPG" />
